input_boundary: local ignored audit sheet only; no private row content is emitted
reference_transcript_policy: Reference transcripts are treated as already human-reviewed ground truth for WER/CER scoring; do not route duplicate transcript review unless future review fields or content differ from the accepted ground-truth transcript fields.
remaining_review_scope: Remaining selected-300 review work is limited to risk-atom labels, decision-change labels, expected safe action, confidence, per-model assessment fields, and per-row review timing.
